'''Aduba-2''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Aduba (star)|Aduba]] in the [[Aduba system/Legends|Aduba system]],<ref name="GC" /> located in the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Aduba-2 was a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] terrestrial world without any [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of three terrestrial planets in the system.<ref name="GC" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Aduba system/Legends|Aduba system]], except [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]], were designed for the article ''[[The Starhoppers of Aduba-3]]'', published in the [[2001]] magazine [[Star Wars Gamer 4|''Star Wars Gamer'' 4]], which provided information for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GC" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Aduba star system in grid square U-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
